title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: admitting goods and their booking to a category
content:
## Rule
An application under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product is admitted to the category that matches the declared goods. The booking carrying the goods must be a live booking whose cargo type is dangerous goods. The declared IMDG class must be one of the category's eligible classes and the packing group one of its eligible packing groups; goods that fit a category only as limited quantities belong to AHL DG Limited Quantity, and goods in a class outside every list are not carried. The booking's equipment type must be among the category's allowed equipment types, its trade lane among the category's allowed trade lanes and its port of discharge outside the category's prohibited ports. The container count may not exceed the category's maximum containers per acceptance, and the gross weight may not exceed the category's maximum per acceptance nor, divided evenly over the containers, its maximum per container. When the category requires a contract-rated booking, the booking must be rated under a service contract. The applicant must in addition meet the profile-age, misdeclaration-block and waiting-period conditions of the same admission rule. The application is registered as submitted with an initial declaration awaiting the shipper's signature.

## Admission checklist
| # | Test | Passes when |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Booking status | the booking is requested, confirmed or equipment released |
| 2 | Booking cargo type | recorded as dangerous goods |
| 3 | Class | on the category's list |
| 4 | Packing group | on the category's list |
| 5 | Limited-quantity routing | goods that fit only as limited quantities go to AHL DG Limited Quantity |
| 6 | Equipment type of the booking | on the category's list |
| 7 | Trade lane of the booking | on the category's list |
| 8 | Port of discharge of the booking | not on the category's prohibited list |
| 9 | Containers | not more than the category's maximum per acceptance |
| 10 | Gross weight | not more than the category's maximum per acceptance |
| 11 | Gross weight divided evenly over the containers | not more than the category's maximum per container |
| 12 | Contract rating | rated under a service contract, where the category requires it |

The booking tests rest on the line's booking record, identified by the booking concerned, and are made before the application is registered.

## Booking status (tests 1 and 2)
| Booking status | Live for admission |
|---|---|
| requested | yes |
| confirmed | yes |
| equipment released | yes |
| any other status | no |

A booking that is live but not recorded with cargo type dangerous goods does not pass either.

## Worked case on weight (hypothetical ceilings)
Assume a category ceiling of 21000 kg per container and 70000 kg per acceptance.
- 3 containers, 64500 kg: 64500 is within 70000, but divided evenly over 3 containers it is 21500 kg per container, above 21000 — not admitted.
- 3 containers, 62400 kg: 20800 kg per container and 62400 within 70000 — both weight tests pass.
